title: The Sturm-sequence conjecture for $(q,t)$-Hoggatt sums
statement:
For integers $q>0$ and $m=2,3$, let $H_n^{[m]}(q,t)$ denote the $(q,t)$-Hoggatt sums. **The Sturm-sequence conjecture.** The polynomial sequence

$$
\{H_n^{[m]}(q,t)\}_{n\geq 1}
$$

forms a Sturm sequence. The authors verified this computationally for $1\leq q\leq 10$ and $1\leq n\leq 15$; the case $q=1$ is established by the paper's theorem, while the general claim remains open.
references:
**3 papers in this index state this conjecture** (2022–2025). The statement above is taken from the most recent of them; the others are [arXiv:2403.19692](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.19692), [arXiv:2212.10586](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.10586).

Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.05873

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2025).
source_name: Hanqian Fang, Candice X. T. Zhang and James J. Y. Zhao, “Analytic properties arising from the Baxter numbers”, arXiv:2505.05873 (2025).
